caption: The drawing depicts a single spur with an attached leather strap. The leather strap is brown with a decorative pattern running along its length, and it features a silver or gray metal floral concho on the side. The spur itself is metallic with a textured, diagonal stripe pattern and consists of a large circular opening connected to a rowel, which has multiple evenly spaced, pointed arms radiating outward in a star-like shape. The spur is positioned with the strap curled into a nearly closed loop, and the objects are displayed centrally on a plain, off-white background with no other elements present.
title: Spur
